messages.text: QQ the b30 can be used to mine only (1) pool or do you have to mine dual pools? newbie question sorry i would rather keep that 30th on (1) pool.

One pool. The B30 points at a single pool — you set it in the dashboard and that's it, all 30 TH/s on that one. No dual mining, no split hashrate.

At 405 W it's about $29 a month at 10¢/kWh. What do you pay for power?
